title: One-Pan Chicken and Chorizo Rice
summary: A hearty Spanish-style rice skillet with smoky chorizo, tender chicken, peppers and tomato. It’s savoury, colourful and ideal for a comforting weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: chicken thigh, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large deep frying pan or sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the chorizo and cook for 2–3 minutes until it starts to release its oil and turn slightly crisp at the edges.
Add the chicken thigh pieces and cook for 4–5 minutes, turning until lightly browned on the outside. They do not need to be fully cooked through yet.
Stir in the onion and red pepper. Cook for 4 minutes until the onion softens, then add the garlic, smoked paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper. Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, rice and water. Stir well, scraping up any browned bits from the pan, then bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and simmer for 18–20 minutes without stirring, until the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the peas, cover again, and cook for 2–3 minutes more until the peas are hot and the chicken is cooked through.
Turn off the heat and rest for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice with a fork, sprinkle over the parsley, and serve straight from the pan.
